scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names BACKEND,FRONTEND --prefix-colors blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "wait-on --timeout 60000 --interval 500 http-get://127.0.0.1:3000/health && npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names BACKEND,FRONTEND --prefix-colors blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev:watch" "wait-on --timeout 60000 --interval 500 http-get://127.0.0.1:3000/health && npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run check && npm --prefix frontend run build
